description: This Java class 'DittoService' is an abstract base implementation for a Ditto service. It manages startup procedures, configuration, actor system initialization, embedded metrics, health checks, and cluster management for the service. The class provides hooks for customization and encapsulates common setup logic for derived services.

classes.name: DittoService
classes.description: Abstract base class for a Ditto service responsible for startup, configuration, actor system management, metrics, and cluster coordination.

classes.name: RootActorInformation
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulatingProps and name for a root actor.
